Define Biodiversity and explain the impo: • Definition: Biological diversity is the degree of variation within or among the species exist on different regions of the earth.
• Importance: It provides many beneficial products which includes fiber, oil, dyes, rubber, water, timber, paper and food.
• Ecosystem Stability: It stabilizes the ecosystem by recycling nutrients, reduces pollution via forests, and plays an important role in drug discovery.
Describe the relationship of Biology wit: 1. Biophysics: The branch in which laws and techniques of physics are applied to explain the processes of life (e.g., radiophysics, carbon-dating, ultrasound).
2. Biomathematics/Biometry: The branch of mathematics which collects data of living organisms. It plays a very important role in research.
3. Biochemistry: The branch of biology which deals with the study of molecules which form living organisms or cells.
Write the contribution of any three Musl: 1. Jabir Bin Hayan (722-817 A.D): Wrote a number of books on plants and animals; 'Al-Nabatiat' and 'Al-Haywan' are his two famous books.
2. Abdul Malik Asmai (741-828 A.D): Great zoologist who wrote 'Al-Kheil' (on horse), 'Al-Ibil' (on camels), 'Al-Shat' (on sheep), and 'Khalqul Insan' (on human body parts).

Explain the term Hypothesis with the hel: • Definition: An intelligent guess made by a scientist in the form of a statement. A hypothesis must be testable through experimentation.
• Example: In the case of malaria observations, scientists formulated the hypothesis: 'Plasmodium is the cause of malaria.'
Write three differences between Theory a: • A Scientific Theory is a well-tested and highly reliable scientific explanation of natural phenomena that unifies many repeated observations.
• A Scientific Law is a uniform or constant fact of nature, making it virtually an irrefutable theory.
• Biology is short in laws due to the puzzling and ever-changing nature of living things.
Define: Paleontology, Environmental biol: • Paleontology: The study of remote past organic life, with the help of fossils.
• Environmental biology: The study of the relationship between living organisms and non-living factors of the environment and their effects on each other.
• Genetics: The study of heredity, that is transferring of characters from parents to offspring.
Mitochondria are called the 'Power house: 1. Double-membrane bound organelle responsible for carrying out cellular aerobic respiration.
2. Converts food energy into Adenosine Triphosphate (ATP) molecules.
3. Acts as the primary power generating network for all metabolic cellular activities.
Write the three differences between apop: • Apoptosis is programmed cell death (cellular suicide) triggered by internal signals.
• Necrosis is accidental or forced cell death caused by severe injury, infection, or toxins.
• Apoptosis maintains tissue integrity without inflammation, whereas necrosis bursts the cell wall and causes damaging localized inflammation.
What is cell theory? And state its postu: • Definition: A foundational biological principle stating that cells form the basic unit of life.
• Postulate 1: All living organisms are composed of one or more cells.
• Postulate 2: The cell is the most fundamental structural and functional unit of all organisms.
• Postulate 3: New cells arise only from pre-existing cells through cell division.
